title: Heart Sutra 1 San Miguel de Allende
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of this Soto Zen dharma talk is that true understanding and wisdom come from looking beyond superficial assumptions about reality. The Heart Sutra, a key Buddhist text, encourages us to question our conventional views and seek deeper insight by exploring the nature of emptiness and non-duality. By embracing this approach, we can cultivate a more profound and nuanced understanding of the world and ourselves.
